coverage: Whole hospital group · single healthcare services segment
definition: Profit after tax attributable to owners of Rainbow Children’s Medicare, after excluding the earnings belonging to non-controlling shareholders of subsidiaries. This is not hospital EBITDA or profit by specialty.
location: PDF page 12 · consolidated annual statement; PDF page 13 · notes 1, 5, 6 and 8
notes: Source figures are ₹ million and are divided by 10. Revenue excludes other income. Total group PAT is ₹281.544 crore, of which ₹3.221 crore belongs to non-controlling interests. The company reports one healthcare segment; maternity, paediatrics and individual hospitals are not assigned invented profits. Acquired hospitals contribute only from their respective consolidation dates.
insight: Hospital revenue must cover doctors, staff, consumables, facilities, depreciation, financing and tax before profit remains for owners. When investigating expansion, compare newer hospitals’ occupancy and cash needs with mature centres; this group total alone does not show whether every hospital is profitable.
